artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan (4 mandatory, 2 optional) landing FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/ZTimeSharpness.lean with nine theorems proving prior_UZ and z1 are not Base-valid, plus Axioms.lean docstring sharpness citations and one budgeted full rebuild.

memory_candidates.content: Lean phase-ordering rule for plans that must edit a widely-imported module: Lean invalidates its build cache on whole-file hash, so even a docstring-only edit to a root module (e.g. ProofSystem/Axioms.lean, transitively imported by the whole tree) forces a full rebuild. Sequence such plans so that (1) new leaf modules are authored and verified first via lean_run_code with no lake build at all, (2) aggregator/import wiring is verified by a SCOPED guarded build while the root module is still untouched and therefore cheap, (3) every prose/docstring edit to the root module is batched into a single phase, and (4) exactly one full detached guarded rebuild plus the gate set follows. Splitting docstring edits across phases, or placing the scoped wiring build after the root-module edit, multiplies full rebuilds with no verification gain. The same ordering applies to any language whose build cache keys on whole-file content rather than on exported interfaces.
